text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hayahide, Ikuno! Sorry for keeping you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is that the book?! Our efforts have borne
fruit at
last!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The book recommendation guide
designed for
non-readers we toiled over
so long!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is our guide to
encourage
reading during fall reading
week among those
who hate books.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Our free publication, The Readers' Guide to Making Reading Fun ♪, is complete at last!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And you two are to thank for all your
help! As a
student librarian, I couldn't be
more grateful.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's have a look inside, shall we?
We can
start with Hayahide's
recommendations...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The theme for my article was "trends." I
included
many books that modern
students would find
interesting to read.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's filled with the most cutting-edge and
latest
theories on racing submitted from
the world of
academia!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... So with your entries, anyone
could easily
stay up to date with
trending theories!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I think students who like to follow trends
will find
that very interesting!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Next is me. I made my recommendations
around
the theme "dreams."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In column format, I've listed numerous
books from which you can learn various
management
techniques useful toward
achieving your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see! And since your lineup of books is
primarily business-related, you've
included explanations to
help students
with their comprehension.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Your article is sure to help students work
toward
their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, um... well... I decided to be
adventurous and
went with the theme
"humor."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The title of my article is "How to Enjoy
The Tale
of Don Quixote Through Other
Literature"!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Interesting... You aim to give a unique 
perspective on the history of 17th
century
literature by means of modern
interpretation.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Once they've read your
recommendations, I'm positive they'll
keel over with laughter at Don
Quixote's
antics!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I agree! When I think about all the
new readers
that'll come from our zine...
I get so excited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their free zine becomes a big hit, and
reading week enjoys a boon of
popularity... among the
already existing
reader circle.
